description: Patient developed gastric pain and black tarry stools after 3 days of diclofenac use. Endoscopy confirmed gastric ulceration.
notes: Patient had history of NSAID allergy which was not documented. System flag updated.

description: Patient reported increased anxiety and insomnia in first week of fluoxetine therapy. Symptoms resolved with dose timing adjustment.
notes: Counseled patient on timing (morning vs evening). Changed to morning dosing - symptoms improved.

description: Patient complained of severe muscle pain and weakness. CPK levels elevated at 2500 U/L. Suspected statin-induced rhabdomyolysis.
notes: Statin discontinued. Patient referred back to cardiologist. Monitoring CPK and renal function.
